notes.title: Reworked Demo is now LIVE
notes.content:
Greetings, Faeologists!

We're excited to announce that our majorly reworked demo is now LIVE as part of the Otome Games Celebration!
https://i.imgur.com/n6vripB.jpeg

Following your feedback from the last demo, we’ve completed a major overhaul of the narrative and script to deepen character development, refine investigation and deduction mechanics, and fully immerse you in the 1920s atmosphere.

An overview of the changes:

 Major script rewrite to give characters more depth and better reflect the 1920s vibe.
Many dialogue options are changed for better flow after narrative rework.
 Character personality changes: 
Florence, who was once portrayed as an unreliable chemist obsessed with the occult, now is a skilled chemist with a lively personality, though there’s a hint of sorrow beneath her cheerful exterior.
Theodore, who was previously portrayed as hot-tempered and single-minded in his pursuit of justice (with occasional poetic flair), now is more composed and direct, while still retaining his natural cynicism and skepticism toward all things fae-related.
 More comprehensive deduction phase with the detective. In the previous demo, there were only two answers for each question. Now you must present your deduction of the culprit with the right evidence. Theo can sniff you out if you are making up stuff!
 Changes to certain evidence items (hair samples into blood samples) and the inclusion of new ones (e.g. wedding ring) to enrich the investigation experience.
 Two additional endings, from five to seven.

https://i.imgur.com/26Uk5EF.jpeg
With these changes, we hope to provide a more polished and immersive experience that reflects the full vision for Death & Faeology.

We'd also like to invite you to check other wonderful visual novels showcased in the event and celebrate otome games with us!
Otome Games Celebration Steam Page

We hope you try the updated demo now and dive into the mystery of Death & Faeology!

notes.title: A Huge Thank You and Where We're Headed
notes.content:
Greetings, Faeologist!

As the Visual Novel Fest comes to a close, we would like to thank you for playing the demo and sharing your thoughts with us. Your feedback has been invaluable in helping us identify areas for improvement.

💠 You can still share your feedback of the demo: Death & Faeology Demo Feedback

While we’ve addressed several bugs and made some enhancements, we feel the demo is still far from where we’d like it to be. With that in mind, we will be taking the demo down from Steam for now so we can focus on further improvements and fully dive into the development of Chapter 1.


Here's a little sneak peek at what’s coming in chapter 1:

The appearance of Ruthie Blythe, the childhood friend (which will also be romanceable in the full game)

Continuation of the current case and more mysteries to solve

Minerva will be romanceable


We also wanted to let you know that, in addition to the Death & Faeology team, we have another team currently working on a brand-new game for this year’s Otome Jam! If you’re interested in following updates for both Death & Faeology and our upcoming project, feel free to follow us on any of our social media :)

Thank you once again for your support! 💛

notes.title: Demo Out Today until February 25!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/BZNy6N5.png
Dear Faeologist,

Death & Faeology demo is now out as a part of the Storyteller's Festival! The prologue episode will be available to play from February 18 - 25.

The demo features:

 2 new sparkling CGs
 Gameplay and visual improvements
 2 mature male love interest: Theo, and Oscar
 5 different endings: 3 good ending, and 2 bad endings
 2 epilogues
 Approximately 20k words to make you think and keep you entertained for around 2 hours 

https://i.imgur.com/ZWFSkjR.png

Go grab the demo and play it while it's available! For any bug report, please reply on this thread:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/3369020/discussions/0/720116096634520258/

May your findings be intriguing!
